project_goal: Build a fail-closed, resumable data-generation agent that reads Feishu seeds and knowledge, generates or augments questions, runs the six-stage review pipeline, and writes allowlisted results and counters back to Feishu.

features.title: Audit lao review stages
acceptance: The active quality and legacy difficulty entrypoints are identified.
Legacy decision semantics, artifacts, resume behavior, and risks are documented.
verification: Read-only source audit of laokuoyang modules and pipeline config.
features.notes: Historical completed work. The old difficulty program is a one-shot prescreen, not passrate.

features.title: Extract quality review adapter
acceptance: Active prompts preflight as strict YAML and valid output-schema JSON.
The legacy two-stage CLI returns normalized ACCEPT, REJECT, or ERROR records.
Conflicts, missing outputs, invalid responses, and duplicate input IDs fail closed.
verification: Bounded synthetic real-API smoke recorded in progress.md
features.notes: Answer-key verification remains an unfinished quality precheck.

features.title: Extract the legacy one-shot difficulty adapter
acceptance: The old program is callable behind a normalized contract.
The result exposes passrate as null and validates legacy scores.
verification: Historical adapter tests and bounded gateway smoke recorded in progress.md
features.notes: Superseded as a public name by F007; retained as a compatibility entrypoint only.

features.title: Establish initial offline adapter suite
acceptance: Initial quality and legacy-difficulty unit and integration tests pass without network access.
features.notes: Historical checkpoint; later semantic changes require their own verification feature.

features.title: Run initial bounded adapter smoke tests
acceptance: Synthetic quality fixtures receive normalized terminal results.
One objective question completes through the previously verified gateway.
Repeated result IDs are stable and the recorded logs contain no detected secret.
verification: Historical commands and results in progress.md
features.notes: Does not activate the renamed difficulty-prescreen contract introduced later.

features.title: Create the project PRD and durable Harness specification
acceptance: docs/PRD.md explains requirements, current repository state, architecture, permissions, memory, prompt composition, and Feishu synchronization.
Every product module has inputs, outputs, implementation steps, risks, dependencies, and Harness Definition of Done.
The PRD defines fail-closed release gates, recovery tests, milestones, terminal states, and unresolved user decisions.
feature_list.json, progress.md, README_AGENT.md, and pipeline config agree with the PRD.
verification: python -c YAML/JSON parse of configs and feature_list
features.notes: Completed with 21 offline tests, JSON/YAML parsing, Python compilation, and Markdown fence validation.

features.title: Reverify lao_difficulty_prescreen v1
acceptance: HARD maps to gate PASS, EASY maps to REJECT_TOO_EASY, and errors quarantine.
passrate remains null for every outcome.
The verified judge gateway is the temporary default; direct Qwen routing is an explicit opt-out.
Offline, idempotency, bounded real smoke, and secret-scan evidence all pass before the manifest is enabled.
verification: Bounded one-question real smoke with default routing
Secret-pattern scan of logs and artifacts
features.notes: Activated after a bounded default-gateway smoke, stable result-id/one-row resume check, 17 targeted tests, and a zero-match scan across 16 runtime artifacts.

features.title: Harden tool execution and secret boundaries
acceptance: Legacy subprocesses receive only allowlisted environment variables.
stdout, stderr, exceptions, and process metadata never expose configured secrets.
Disabled manifests are enforced by runtime code, and fixed command/path policies prevent arbitrary execution.
Input content changes cannot reuse stale legacy results.
verification: Environment allowlist and fake-secret redaction tests
features.notes: Completed with allowlisted subprocess environments, uniform redaction, normalized timeout/errors, runtime manifest enforcement, path containment, and stale same-ID content detection. Production HTTP gateway trust and HTTPS/mTLS policy remains a deployment decision.

features.title: Build the durable Harness runtime
acceptance: SQLite stores jobs, candidates, revisions, attempts, events, artifacts, leases, budgets, trials, and outbox records.
The explicit state graph rejects disabled or missing required stages.
Crash recovery does not duplicate confirmed model calls or logical results.
CLI supports preflight, run, status, resume, retry, cancel, and reconcile.
verification: Crash injection at every commit boundary
features.notes: Completed with SQLite migrations, CAS state/event transactions, immutable artifacts, fencing leases, atomic budgets, durable trials/outbox tables, recovery chaos tests, and a fail-closed CLI.

features.title: Implement Feishu Base snapshot ingestion
acceptance: Only registered Base/table/view/fields can be read.
Pagination, retries, incremental cursors, source revisions, and immutable snapshots are supported.
Every source record is normalized or explicitly rejected.
features.notes: Completed with allowlisted pagination, per-page crash resume, immutable snapshots, and a live 3-record personal-Base read: 3 accepted, 0 rejected, stable repeat snapshot, zero registered-resource leaks.

features.title: Implement knowledge and persona snapshots
acceptance: Wiki/Docs content is frozen into versioned, citable knowledge chunks.
Persona templates are schema-validated, versioned generation constraints.
Retrieval is reproducible within a run and treats document text as untrusted data.
features.notes: Completed with immutable source/persona versions, stable citations, deterministic scoped retrieval, untrusted-document handling, and content-addressed Prompt packages. A representative supply-chain persona and adversarial knowledge fixture provide the offline golden evidence; production scope remains a deployment input.

features.title: Integrate consistency review
acceptance: Only quality-accepted, prescreen-passed revisions can run.
The tool returns exactly one PASS, FAIL, or ERROR with structured conflict evidence.
Missing inputs, evidence conflicts, and tool errors fail closed.
features.notes: Completed as consistency_review@1.0.0 with four code-derived checks, strict evidence citations, same-revision upstream gating, retry/resume, stale-result rejection, and a stable one-record DeepSeek Flash real smoke.

features.title: Integrate reference-answer synthesis
acceptance: Only consistency-PASS revisions can synthesize an answer.
The result is versioned, typed by question form, citable, and usable by the scorer.
Synthesis failure never creates an empty or implicit answer.
features.notes: Completed as answer_synthesis@1.0.0 with typed answers, approved citations, same-revision consistency gating, fixed GPT-5.5 32768-token requests, durable resume, and a stable real smoke.

features.title: Integrate multi-trial Qwen passrate review
acceptance: Every trial has a stable trial_id and can be resumed without duplicate execution.
Requested, completed, valid, passed, passrate, and uncertainty fields are reproducible from trial records.
Invalid outputs and insufficient valid trials cannot produce a passing difficulty decision.
verification: Small real multi-trial smoke with budget cap
features.notes: Completed as qwen_passrate_review@1.0.0 with durable composite-keyed Qwen 32k trials, the exact DeepSeek scoring Prompt at concurrency 20, resumable answer/judge commits, deterministic aggregation, and a two-trial real canary.

features.title: Implement the deterministic final gate
acceptance: The gate uses no model or network.
Only same-revision, same-policy, valid passing results can emit FINAL_ACCEPTED.
Missing, stale, disabled, invalid, or error results produce explicit non-accept terminal states.
features.notes: This is the only component allowed to emit FINAL_ACCEPTED.

features.title: Implement Feishu allowlisted Outbox and counters
acceptance: Models and review tools cannot write Feishu directly.
Outbox patches only registered field IDs and is idempotent across retries and lost acknowledgements.
Per-batch, task-type, question-type, and stage pending/passed/rejected/quarantined counts rebuild from state events.
Development Base readback exactly matches local committed state.
verification: Full counter rebuild and zero-drift reconciliation
features.notes: Completed against the personal development Base: business-key idempotent seed/candidate/progress writes, verified readback before ACK, lost-ACK recovery, event counter rebuild/update, and zero-drift reconciliation. Production Base IDs remain unconfigured.

features.title: Implement question generation
acceptance: Generated candidates carry seed, persona, knowledge, policy, model, and Prompt provenance.
Generation never marks a candidate accepted and every candidate enters the review chain.
Idempotency, budget, diversity, and duplicate controls are enforced.
features.notes: Start with one question type and one persona family.

features.title: Implement controlled question augmentation
acceptance: Every child records parent lineage and a versioned transformation policy.
must_preserve, may_change, must_change, and forbidden mutations are validated.
Every child receives independent answer and review results.
features.notes: Question-type-specific augmentation policies must be enabled independently.

features.title: Implement bounded Agentic repair
acceptance: Only allowlisted issue-code-to-action mappings can revise a candidate.
AUDIT_ONLY never changes a question.
Every repair creates a new revision and invalidates affected downstream results.
Attempt, token, cost, time, and no-progress limits terminate loops automatically.
verification: Revision invalidation and full re-review tests
features.notes: Tool or infrastructure errors are never repair prompts.

features.title: Pass full shadow, canary, release, and rollback validation
acceptance: Audit, generation, augmentation, repair, six-stage review, and Feishu synchronization pass end-to-end.
Crash/recovery, budget, security, secret scan, counter reconciliation, and semantic regression gates pass.
A structured release-evidence artifact binds code, Prompt, model, policy, knowledge, schema, and test hashes.
Rollback to the previous verified version is rehearsed without deleting history.
features.notes: Only after this feature may configs/question_pipeline.yaml set full_pipeline_enabled to true.
